:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-score}

$$
\ba
\score(\pmean; \vx)
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-n\logf{\pmean} - \frac{n\rvarbar}{\pmean}}
&& \text{(log-likelihood from the log-likelihood exercise)}
\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-n\logf{\pmean} - n\rvarbar\pmean^{-1}}
&& \text{(write $\tfrac{n\rvarbar}{\pmean}$ as $n\rvarbar\pmean^{-1}$)}
\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-n\logf{\pmean}} - \deriv{\pmean}\paren{n\rvarbar\pmean^{-1}}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}
\\
&= -n\deriv{\pmean}\logf{\pmean} - n\rvarbar\deriv{\pmean}\pmean^{-1}
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}
\\
&= -n\pmean^{-1} - n\rvarbar\deriv{\pmean}\pmean^{-1}
&& \text{(derivative of $\log$)}
\\
&= -n\pmean^{-1} - n\rvarbar\paren{-\pmean^{-2}}
&& \text{(power rule)}
\\
&= -n\pmean^{-1} + n\rvarbar\pmean^{-2}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\\
&= -\frac{n}{\pmean} + \frac{n\rvarbar}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(write the negative powers as fractions)}
\\
&= -\frac{n\pmean}{\pmean^2} + \frac{n\rvarbar}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(write both terms over the common denominator)}
\\
&= \frac{-n\pmean + n\rvarbar}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(combine the fractions)}
\\
&= \frac{n\rvarbar - n\pmean}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(reorder the numerator)}
\\
&= \frac{n}{\pmean^2}\paren{\rvarbar - \pmean}
&& \text{(factor out $\tfrac{n}{\pmean^2}$)}
\ea
$$

:::
